history.text: On my Flows tab, why does some product go from a plant to a warehouse that's far away instead of the closest one?

Flows are optimized jointly across both echelons, subject to the capability matrix's feasibility restrictions and the cardinality constraint on open warehouses, so the marginal cost of an inbound lane is traded off against the outbound assignment costs and the plant's product-mix eligibility.
